description:
Verify + standardize an address column via Precisely Address Verify.

Example:
    ```yaml
    type: dagster_community_components.PreciselyAddressVerifyComponent
    attributes:
      asset_name: verified_customer_addresses
      upstream_asset_key: customer_raw_addresses
      address_column: full_address
      country_column: country_code        # optional; defaults to USA
      output_prefix: av_
      client_id_env_var: PRECISELY_CLIENT_ID
      client_secret_env_var: PRECISELY_CLIENT_SECRET
    ```

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with the address column.

address_column.label: Address Column
address_column.description: Source column with the single-line address string ('123 Main St, Springfield, MA 01103'). The API can also accept parsed components — see address_line_columns if you already have street/city/state split out.

address_line_columns.label: Address Line Columns
address_line_columns.description: Optional: pass parsed address parts instead of a single line. Map of {payload_field: source_column}, e.g. {addressLines: street, city: city, postalCode: zip}. When set, address_column is ignored.

country_column.label: Country Column
country_column.description: Optional column with ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code per row. Falls back to default_country when null/missing.

default_country.label: Default Country
default_country.description: Country code used when country_column is missing.

output_prefix.label: Output Prefix
output_prefix.description: Prefix for added columns (default 'av_': av_status, av_standardized, ...).

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var with Precisely OAuth2 client_id.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var with Precisely OAuth2 client_secret.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Addresses per request batch (Address Verify accepts batches).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current date partition (time partitions).
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current static/dynamic partition key.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
